topic: MATT FIELD ON HIS VEGAS LAYOUT
quote: This is how I feel about the track. If the transition from bank to flat was like 10 % better, it would be an amazing, like perfect track. And whether the layout that me and Ryan and Ken chose for the infield was optimal, sure, surely not, right? We could sit here and say, this corner could be this, and this corner could be that. But here's the beautiful thing, we have a contract for a couple years, and the plan is to come back and continue to make it better. By no means, I hope that we do the exact same layout just because there was a successful weekend. There's better stuff out there, so. Let's explore, let's do stuff, and the coolest thing is that the track is all about us and us being here, and I think we put it on an amazing show for the fans, and this is what's most important, not whether we think the track is good, it's whether the fans think the tandem was good, and that's kind of the end of the day.
why: Matt Field reveals he co-designed the Vegas layout, the deal runs a couple of years and the track will change.
photo_hint: The Bullring at Las Vegas Motor Speedway
check_reason: 'Ryan and Ken' assumed to be Ryan Tuerck and Ken Gushi; speaker assumed Matt Field (addressed as Matt).
caption: Matt Field helped design the new Vegas layout, and says it will not stay the same in the coming years. #FormulaDRIFT #FDLV #MattField #LasVegas

guest: JACK SHANAHAN, MATT FIELD, CONOR SHANAHAN
quote: I mean, more than the car. Like it looked like, in general, the whole grid was kind of struggling with temps today. I think, to be honest, it was like the lack of air moving into place at the issue. Like my car, we went through everything, and everything was actually still as good as it has been all season. But even driving around between the lead and the chase, or chase and the lead. Don't cool off. It didn't cool off. I was like, you actually had to go real fast. And like idle for it to work. So it was weird. It was just very, very still air. Drift cars are funny, where they don't do anything other than drift, even unless you're sitting still. Then they do car things. Other than that, they do terrible. It's like the first event that I feel like we couldn't even do donuts, because I finished the second run, and I was like, oh my God, this thing is on X Games mode on the back. I was turning my fan on early. I never touch buttons. Yeah, I never, yeah. My car in the final was hot.
why: The podium explains how still desert air had cars overheating all night, even between runs.
check_reason: Group conversation; speaker of each line not certain.
caption: No wind, no cooling. The Vegas podium on cars running hot all night at the Bullring. #FormulaDRIFT #FDLV #LasVegas

topic: HOW PRO DRIFT CARS STAY COOL
quote: Yeah, yeah, we brought the fans in 10 degrees earlier, just to try to help with the split between two runs, let's say. Do you, question that, now that you mentioned that, do you guys not run fans during the actual run itself, or only if we hit 200, we're bringing them in? Oh no, fans run nearly all the time. We just did a thing. Yeah, the computer was that. We got a computer for that. Yeah, we come on at a certain temperature, basically. When the car reaches a certain temperature, the fans come on.
why: A quick look at how teams run cooling fans in a Pro drift car.
check_reason: Group conversation; speaker of each line not certain.
caption: The fans came on 10 degrees earlier in Vegas. How Pro teams keep their drift cars cool between runs. #FormulaDRIFT #FDLV #DriftTech

topic: JACK'S CAR: JUST TIRES AND FUEL
quote: I want to go to sleep, to be honest. But other than that, not really. I think we're sitting forward, but much closer to second now than we have been, so that's cool. You're like one battle up and you're in second, basically. Oh yeah, well, sweet, we can do that, you know? So, yeah, no, to be honest, if we can finish one, two in the championship, the first time we've done an approach championship since, I think we've done it in BDC. I think it's 2017. It's quite cool, you know what I mean? So if we can finish that strong, I wouldn't be mad at all. That would be fairly fucking cool, to be honest. So, yeah, no, my second year here, and with relatively small program, like low budgets and building the car in such a short time, I'm more than happy, to be honest, with what we've done. The guys are good. Corey's great. Everything has just been working fairly flawlessly, to be honest. Since Long Beach, we had the issues, but since Long Beach, the car has literally had nothing but tires and fuel. It's fairly impressive. So I'm very, very proud of that. It's been quarter panels, tires and fuel.
why: Jack Shanahan on chasing a Shanahan one-two in the title with a low budget car that has needed nothing since Long Beach.
caption: Second year, small budget, and a car that has needed nothing but tires and fuel since Long Beach. Jack Shanahan after the Vegas podium. #FormulaDRIFT #JackShanahan #FDLV

quote: I think the pressure is the fun part, though. Like, pressure to have fun? Or like, you enjoy the pressure? No, when the pressure's there, it's more fun. Got it. I'm having less fun. I've said it, like, walking up and down the grid, you guys have probably heard me, I'm like, I'm bored. You want the stress? Yeah. Yeah. Like, OK, somebody crashes out on track. I'm like, I'm so bored now. Like, I was amped, and I'm in it, and I'm ready to do it, and I'm checking boxes, and we're coming in swinging. And then now it's like, all right, just hang out for another two hours. I'm like, I'm bored. But when there's a championship fight, you're like, all right, I got to get into my head space. I got to do this. I got to do this. You're thinking about this. You're thinking about that. It's just more fun to be in it. Gotcha. I don't know. I'm bored, but at the same time, I'm absolutely thankful that I'm able to be bored, but still compete for wins and still be able to throw down. So that's just a testament to the series and the team.
why: Out of the title fight, Matt Field says racing without championship pressure is less fun.
caption: Out of the title fight, Matt Field says he is bored without the pressure. Drift is more fun when it matters. #FormulaDRIFT #MattField #FDLV

quote: I just got to prepare for Long Beach the same as I prepare for every other race. Like I want to go there and try when they event. That's the goal. Yeah. You know, I kind of said started this weekend, I was asking me about points and this. And I'm like, I'm going to drive hard, try when they event. And we'll look at the points that night and see what we need to do. But I'm really happy in the position that I'm in. Like, you know, we won a long beach, which was like a dream start. And it kind of almost was like too good of a start, because it made us a little bit like and then we had a mechanical in Atlanta. And then I thought it was a great idea to battle James in top 32 in Orlando. And he woke my ass. So I was kind of like, damn, this is like a mechanical atop 32 and I kind of made the year a little bit stressful after a really good start. Then we got back in the podium in Connecticut and yeah, just kind of believe that we can get back in the fight, worked hard. And the boys all worked hard around me. I think when we had the mechanical Atlanta and then we had the top 32 in Orlando, it was kind of like, OK, this is going to be like a foundation year for next year to fight for a championship.
why: Conor Shanahan looks back on a season with a dream start, a mechanical and a lesson from James Deane.
caption: Dream start, then a mechanical and a lesson from James Deane in Orlando. Conor Shanahan on the road to the final round. #FormulaDRIFT #ConorShanahan #JamesDeane

quote: You know, I got to give such props to the guys. They're doing such a good job. Like this weekend, I came done practice for qualifying, qualified really strong. The only change we made to the car is one PSI from the start to the weekend. Yeah, Jackson, not even a shock change. Nothing. OK. And it's like for me, the car is just giving everything I want. I feel no pressure driving the car. It's easy to do good lead runs. It's it's just a really good, happy environment for me to be in. So it kind of makes my driving a lot more fun and I'm enjoying that. And I guess I've had experience with that at the other side of the world.
why: Conor Shanahan says the only setup change all weekend was one PSI of tire pressure.
caption: From practice to the win, the only change to Conor Shanahan's car was one PSI. #FormulaDRIFT #ConorShanahan #FDLV

quote: And yeah, look, of course, I want to be champion. That was the goal at the start of the year. That was the goal coming to Long Beach. There's no point saying it wasn't. If you're not showing up trying to be a champion, there's no point coming to the racetrack. So of course, we're in a good position now, but it's drifting. It's not over until it's over. And yeah, we just got to keep working hard. I'm not going to get lazy. The team is not going to get lazy. They're going to do everything on their side to check everything, what they need to check to make sure that they give me the car in Long Beach. And yeah, fingers crossed I can try to get the job doing and be it's my dream. It's the dream of 12 year old Connor sitting at home in the couch watching Formula Drift and yeah, be pretty special moment if it happens. But I'm not going to think about the moment until the trophy is in my hand.
why: One round from the title, Conor Shanahan talks about the dream he had as a kid watching Formula DRIFT.
caption: One round to go and Conor Shanahan is not thinking about the title until the trophy is in his hand. #FormulaDRIFT #ConorShanahan #FDLV

quote: And actually, this weekend has been a lot of fun. Yeah, we've done nothing because we've been had jet lag. It's been a long couple of weeks. Poland, James event has been and, you know, good driving at all those events. But those when you're doing it back to back, it gets a little bit tiring. So we slept a lot this week. But we me and Jack share Airbnb at all the races. So me and Matt stay at Jack's Airbnb with his team. And yeah, we have a lot of fun. We stay up. We're watching this weekend. Was a bit of a crack. Be fair. We're watching movies. You're like, as if you're watching one last night. But it's a lot of fun. And that's what it's about for for me to a lot of it is just enjoy the moment. Be grateful that we're here and to do it alongside. My big brother is always quite special to have those moments.
why: Conor Shanahan on sharing an Airbnb with brother Jack at every race and why that matters.
caption: Same Airbnb at every round, movie nights included. Conor Shanahan on doing it all with his big brother Jack. #FormulaDRIFT #ConorShanahan #JackShanahan

topic: NINE FLIGHTS CHANGED IN ONE YEAR

But I'm just like I get up and I'm like, I don't want to get on a plane. See, that says 10 K. So I'm black tonight. Change the fucking flight. You're such a good influence. But I love it. I love it. Yeah, Jack's kind of trying to convince me. And then this guy's like change the flight. I would not waste that money.
why: A driver admits he changed nine flights this year just to stay in bed, and the podium eggs him on.
caption: Nine flights changed this year, and not because of partying. The Vegas podium on the art of staying in bed. #FormulaDRIFT #FDLV #LasVegas
